sections.text: مقدمة

يوضح هذا المستند فحص المعدات I1، الذي يجب إجراؤه عليه 
القواعد الأسبوعية كما هو موضح بواسطة W1 في كتلة العنوان.

The AS111 module is 
an analog output module providing 8 outputs (4-20 mA current) referenced with 
respect to the process voltage 0 V
شائع.

The first draft is initiated by eng. Amal El-Shamy, tested by 
eng. Bahaa Abd El-Wahab, revised by MDEPC quality control eng. Adel El Naggar, accepted by 
general manager eng. Mohamed Elshreif, approved by eng. Ahmed Sawan head sector 
of Nubaria power station.

This document certified by eng. Samir Abd El Gillil 
MDEPC quality control general manager and MPIS coordinator and approved by eng. Mohammed Nageb 
quality control head sector.

Input-output registers.

sections.text: Controls and indications on the front panel

A green LED on the front panel indicates if the 
module is working.

It remains on if the module is operating correctly 
and goes out in case of faulty operation ( fault detected in the hardware or 
configuration use of the module)

sections.text: Input elements

The module has 16 logic input elements 
for acquisition of 16 free contacts.

Each element is based on an opto-isolator 
which provides galvanic isolation between the process and the internal voltages.

The module monitors the possibility of 
the inputs to be switched to 1 or 0.

sections.text: Process voltage

The process voltage is 
supplied by the backplane connector (distributed voltage), or by the process 
connector (external voltage).

A logic input based on an 
opto-isolator indicates the presence of the process voltage.
